name: The Collector
source:
A monster lurking in a cave. Collects things it takes interest in, attatching them to its body. Has no real physical form, is simply a mass of the things it has collected.

Does not speak, but seems to possibly understand speech.

Does not seem to appreciate people trying to steal the things it has collected.
